# Final status

Codex Powerpack 0.2.2 is packaged as a public open-source distribution.

## Verified capabilities

- 8 Codex-native agents
- 249 redistribution-audited skills
- minimal, standard and full profiles
- project-scoped installation, update, uninstall and rollback
- guided project adaptation with reviewable plans
- optional Codebase Memory and Graphify integrations
- local validation, release manifests and SHA-256 checksums

## Licensing boundary

First-party files use MIT. Included third-party skills preserve local license or notice files. Components without a preserved license were removed from the public package.
